startup_wav.label: Startup sound (WAV)
startup_wav.cli_help: Path to 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAVE startup clip

shutter_wav.label: Shutter sound (WAV)
shutter_wav.cli_help: Path to 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAVE shutter clip

profile_cli_help: Build profile: shutter-feedback (default, requires two WAVs) or xpan-crop (no WAVs; silent unless --record-indicator or --record-stop-indicator)
profile_exclusivity: Choose either XPan or custom startup and shutter sounds.

profiles.label: Custom startup and shutter sounds
profiles.description: Plays your own startup clip after the camera starts and your own shutter clip on single shots, through the camera speaker. No XPan.
profiles.status_detail: Both sounds played during normal photo shooting.

profiles.label: XPan 2.71:1 crop (silent)
profiles.description: Replaces 16:9 with a 2.71:1 XPan crop: menu and Q label, live LCD/EVF framing, saved JPEG/RAW crop, playback masking and immediate XPan bars in automatic review. Adds no sounds unless you pick a record start or stop cue.
profiles.status_detail: Tests covered the menu, live framing, RAW + Large JPEG capture, playback and automatic review. Other image qualities, modes and active auto-rotation remain unverified.

options.label: Movie record indicator
options.description: Plays a short generated start cue when you press the movie REC button. Independent of the stop cue. No audio files are needed.
options.unavailable_reason: The record indicator is part of the XPan profile only (it needs xpan-crop).
options.cli_help: xpan-crop only: opt-in movie record indicator cue played on the Movie REC button press (default off; 'ding' is the cue tested on a private lab build)

choices.label: Ding: struck-bar chime, 250 ms
choices.status_detail: The ding sounded when REC was pressed, both on its own and with the stop cue enabled.

choices.label: Chirp: two rising notes, 120 ms
choices.status_detail: The chirp sounded on a REC press in an earlier test.

choices.label: Tone: single 2 kHz beep, 150 ms
choices.status_detail: An earlier test played the tone later in the recording sequence. Its timing on a REC press is unverified.

options.label: Movie record stop cue
options.description: Plays a short generated stop cue once when a movie take ends. Independent of the start cue. No audio files are needed.
options.unavailable_reason: The record stop cue is part of the XPan profile only (it needs xpan-crop).
options.cli_help: xpan-crop only: opt-in movie record stop cue played once when a take ends (default off; independent of --record-indicator; 'dong' is the cue tested on a private lab build)

choices.label: Dong: two falling notes, 250 ms
choices.status_detail: The dong sounded at the end of a take with the start ding enabled. The stop cue alone is untested.

options.label: One-press screenshot (RATE)
options.description: Press RATE anywhere (live view, menus, playback) to save a 2400x1600 JPEG of the whole screen, made by the camera's own encoder, next to your photos. In playback the JPEG is made at once. In live view or a menu the screen is saved at once, and its JPEG appears by itself about 2.5-3 s after you next open playback (the camera presses INFO for you). A button or the joystick used before then cancels that; INFO in playback then delivers it. An XPan photo is replaced by the last photo that gave a screenshot this session. A click confirms the capture; two low bips mean it was refused, three that the camera cancelled it. Each RATE also leaves working files (about 11 MB) in DCIM/R5SHOTS.
options.unavailable_reason: The screenshot is part of the XPan profile only (it needs xpan-crop).
options.cli_help: xpan-crop only: opt-in one-press screenshot on the RATE button (default off; 'rate' saves an in-camera JPEG of the playback screen)

choices.label: RATE anywhere: whole-screen JPEG
choices.status_detail: With both recording cues enabled, RATE captured live view, menus and playback. In the test, opening playback saved the pending JPEG automatically. Moving the joystick cancelled automatic saving; pressing INFO then saved it. Screenshots without either cue are untested.
